title: Hold an authority to generate or transmit electricity
what: Generate electricity, or operate a transmission or distribution network, only under a licence from the Commission.

sources.title: Electricity Act 1996 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on operations in the electricity supply industry for which a licence is required unless the person holds a licence under this Part authorising the relevant operations

sources.title: Electricity Act 1996 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The operations in the electricity supply industry for which a licence is required are— (a) generation of electricity; or (b) operation of a transmission or distribution network
